<span class="lang-pt">Use diretamente no navegador. Gratuitas, sem cadastro.</span>
<span class="lang-en">Use right in your browser. Free, no sign-up.</span>

<div class="webtools-grid" id="webtools-grid"></div>

<script>
  (function () {
    // ── Apps: para adicionar uma ferramenta, basta incluir uma entrada ──
    var APPS = [
      {
        name: 'im-calc-map',
        icon: '<img src="/files/icons/webtools-im-calc-map.svg" alt="">',
        tint: '#f5a623',
        soon: true,
        desc: {
          pt: 'Mapa de eficiência de motor de indução',
          en: 'Induction motor efficiency map'
        }
      },
      {
        name: 'Winding Factor',
        icon: '<img src="/files/icons/webtools-winding-factor.svg" alt="">',
        tint: '#4a90d9',
        href: '/tools/winding-factor/',
        soon: false,
        desc: {
          pt: 'Fator de bobinamento de máquinas elétricas',
          en: 'Winding factor of electrical machines'
        }
      }
    ];

    var grid = document.getElementById('webtools-grid');
    APPS.forEach(function (a) {
      var el = document.createElement(a.soon ? 'div' : 'a');
      el.className = 'webtools-card' + (a.soon ? ' is-coming' : '');
      if (!a.soon) { el.href = a.href; }
      el.style.setProperty('--tint', a.tint);
      el.innerHTML =
        '<div class="webtools-icon">' + a.icon + '</div>' +
        '<div class="webtools-name">' + a.name + '</div>' +
        '<div class="webtools-desc"><span class="lang-pt">' + a.desc.pt + '</span><span class="lang-en">' + a.desc.en + '</span></div>' +
        (a.soon
          ? '<span class="webtools-badge"><span class="lang-pt">Em breve</span><span class="lang-en">Coming soon</span></span>'
          : '');
      grid.appendChild(el);
    });
  })();
</script>

<span class="lang-pt">Mais ferramentas em breve.</span>
<span class="lang-en">More tools coming soon.</span>
